title: C24 - Margin / Liquidation Fidelity Adjudication of the frozen crash-rebound edge
why_c24: C1-C23 closed NO_GO on OKX, Binance UM, MEXC and Bitget using an execution model that force-liquidates at a -(5+1)=6% adverse move (src/backtest/engine.py::_check_liquidation). The published spec's own risk exit is a WIDE safety stop at 8x the usual hourly range (median ~15% below entry on Hyperliquid) and states the 120% coin cap 'leaves margin free'. A 6% forced exit pre-empts the strategy's own stop and is not specified in the PDF. The C1-C23 NO_GO may therefore describe the margin model rather than the strategy. C24 adjudicates exactly this, once, with full inference, before the NO_GO is treated as final.
research_question: Is the pooled spec-literal PnL sign robust to the liquidation distance used by the execution model, across four independent real venues and four folds?

stage0_probe.note: Descriptive only: no bootstrap, permutation, placebo or BH. It may NOT emit a GO token. It exists solely to justify running the C24 inference arm.

signal_path_frozen.drift_rule: Any artifact whose signal_path fields differ from this block is INVALID.

arms_rule: ONLY liquidation_maint_margin_pct / liquidation_buffer_pct / enable_liquidation_checks vary across arms. All other config fields are identical and drift-checked. d15 is PRIMARY because 15% equals the spec's stated median safety-stop distance, so a spec-faithful liquidation model cannot fire before the strategy's own stop.

base_6.why: Frozen config; its 20k/20k/2k inference is already recorded in C20 (OKX, Binance UM), C22 (MEXC) and C23 (Bitget). C24 only re-checks that its campaign PnL reproduces the recorded totals exactly.

d15.why: PRIMARY adjudication arm; full pre-registered battery required.

d10.why: Descriptive threshold-curve point; no inference, no verdict power.

d30.why: Descriptive threshold-curve point; no inference, no verdict power.

noliq.why: Upper bound on margin-model sensitivity; not a fidelity claim.

inference.pooled: venue-blocked bootstrap over the 16 (venue, fold) cell totals (20000 draws)

multiplicity.family: primary arm d15, 4 folds x 4 venues = 16 permutation tests

fidelity_anchor.rule: base_6 must reproduce the recorded C20/C22/C23 pooled PnL within 1.0; otherwise C24 is INVALID and no verdict may be issued.

decision_rules.C24_REOPENS_C1_C23: ALL of: (a) d15 pooled total PnL > 0; (b) venue-blocked bootstrap CI95 lower bound > 0; (c) >= 1 BH survivor in the 16-test d15 family; (d) >= 3 of 4 folds positive; (e) >= 3 of 4 venues positive. Then the C1-C23 NO_GO is NOT robust to a spec-plausible liquidation distance: record SUPERSEDED_BY_C24 and authorize C24-T2 (portfolio-margin fidelity arm + full re-adjudication).
decision_rules.C24_NO_GO_ROBUST_TO_MARGIN: ANY of (a)-(e) fails. Then the NO_GO survives a spec-plausible liquidation distance and is strengthened: record C1-C24 NO_GO ROBUST and CLOSE the program.
decision_rules.C24_UNDERPOWERED: Fidelity anchor mismatch, prereg generated after any compute artifact, draw floors not met, missing artifacts, or signal-path drift.
decision_rules.rule: Both REOPENS and NO_GO_ROBUST are terminal and must be reported with the full arm x venue x fold table, per-leg attribution and exit-reason decomposition. Never report a bare token. C24 is not a GO search: no configuration search, no additional thresholds, no new venues beyond the four.

checkpoint_rule: A (arm, venue, fold) is DONE only when research_state/c24_ckpt_<arm>_<venue>_<fold>_20261119T013154Z.json exists. Resume with --resume; never relaunch completed folds.

provenance.caveat: Real exchange USDT-perp data, non-synthetic, CROSS-VENUE vs the Hyperliquid spec; NEVER Hyperliquid performance evidence and never relabelled as such.

guardrails: No synthetic gap-fill; no spec relaxation of RSI/target/hold/sizing/volume/gross cap.
The liquidation-distance change INCREASES fidelity (the frozen 6% is stricter than the spec's own ~15% median stop); it must never be described as a tuned edge.
No additional liquidation thresholds, venues or folds beyond those pre-registered.
Artifacts are immutable once written; do not edit completed campaign outputs.
